title: Bounded data refill
summary: Download/refill always needs an explicit start and end. Unbounded history is rejected.
narrative:
data.refill writes local tables over the network. The planner requires start and end (YYYYMMDD or a year range). Missing dates become clarify_required / date_range.

A session can fill those dates on the next turn without re-classifying the Job. Full-market refill without symbols is expensive; say so in assumptions.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
print(assistant.plan('download A-share daily data to local datasource', response_style='raw')['plan']['steps'][0]['inputs']['fallback_action'])
risk_notes: Never run unbounded refill. Confirm before execute. allow_refill only gates agent_auto.
